evidence_context: The food and our server were good. They were not kid friendly though. My kids were playing the bean bag toss, and not be loud or anything , but the staff were getting anxious about them, and kicked them out of the bean bag toss area. Honestly the kids were really just playing the game , not being loud, for a place that lets kids come in, I don't know how more well behave kids could be, that the staff wouldn't kick them out of the game area. Wouldn't recommend to tourist or neighborhood families, walk down to Spruce street Harbor Park, were kids are truly welcomed.
